name: print-social-pink-panel-conference-room-booking-photo-post
title: Pink Panel Conference Room Post
whatItIs: A square post with a large soft pink rounded panel carrying a light headline 'Move Things Forward', a subline, a white room-name box and outlined tag pills, beside an overhead meeting photo with a thin pink outlined frame.
whatItMeans: A pastel panel over a real photo feels friendly and modern for workplace communication, and the outline frame adds a designed accent.
techniques: Solid pink panel covering half the photo
Thin outline frame over the photo
Light large headline with a small subline
White info box for the key detail
bestFor: Social posts with a photo and panel split

vocabulary.definition: A solid rounded block laid over an image to hold text.
A thin line rectangle drawn over a photo.
An outlined rounded label with an icon.
